# BT25 Card Audit Ledger

Audit date: 2026-08-24. Scope: all 104 committed BT25 catalog cards, audited one card at a time in ascending ID order with exact catalog and KB evidence, direct-module/shared-primitive tracing, and peer/trait/evolution comparison. Current focused evidence: 85 isolated card files and 288 tests passed, plus 2 current targeted BT25-101 occurrences. Inherited evidence: 19 card files and 125 test clauses received fresh semantic review and were inspected from `origin/audit/bt25-complete`, which is fully contained in `origin/main`; they were not redundantly rerun per coordinator direction. Collection-level typecheck and diff gates are recorded in the completion commit and coordinator notification.

    Q6270 (2026-05-08): What position on the memory gauge does "if your opponent has 5 or more memory" refer to?
      A: It refers to when the memory gauge is at 5 or further to the right on your opponent's side.
    Q6271 (2026-05-08): What position on the memory gauge does "if your opponent has 5 or less memory" refer to?
      A: It refers to when the memory gauge is at 5 or further to the left from your opponent's point of view.
    Q6272 (2026-05-08): What does "effects don't affect" mean, exactly?
      A: This effect prevents a card from being affected by effects. For example, your Digimon won't suspend if it's chosen for a "suspend 1 of your opponent's Digimon" effect, and its DP won't be reduced by 3000 if it's chosen for a "1 of your opponent's Digimon gets -3000 DP" effect.
    Q6273 (2026-05-08): Can a card that has an "effects don't affect" effect be chosen for an effect?
      A: Yes, it can be chosen. For example, a Digimon that isn't affected by effects can be chosen for a "suspend 1 of your opponent's Digimon" effect.
    Q6274 (2026-05-08): Can a card that has an "effects don't affect" effect be given an effect?
      A: Yes, it can. It won't be affected by it, but it can be given an effect. However, if an effect such as <Security A.> is given to a Digimon that isn't affected by effects, the Digimon won't be considered to have that effect.
    Q6275 (2026-05-08): If a card is affected by an effect, then it later gains an "effects don't affect" effect, what happens to the effect that was affecting it?
      A: As soon as it gains the "effects don't affect" effect, it will no longer be affected.
    Q6276 (2026-05-08): If a card has an "effects don't affect" effect, it gains an effect, then it later loses the "effects don't affect" effect, what happens to the effect that it gained?
      A: It will be affected by the effect as soon as it can be affected by effects.
    Q6277 (2026-05-08): A card that has an "effects don't affect" effect was given an effect that triggers at a timing such as [When Attacking]. Will the effect trigger if that card later meets the trigger conditions?
      A: If the Digimon isn't affected by effects upon the trigger timing, the effect won't trigger.

```text
BT25-020 Marsmon
  Q&A (9):
    Q6278 (2026-05-08): What does "may battle" mean, exactly?
      A: This effect directly performs a battle. If this effect is activated, the chosen Digimon battle, as with the standard rules.
    Q6279 (2026-05-08): If 2 Digimon including a Digimon that has an "effects don't affect" effect are chosen for a "may battle" effect, can those Digimon battle?
      A: Yes, they can battle. A card that has an "effects don't affect" effect can still be chosen for an effect. In addition, a battle itself is a rule that compares DP, not an effect. Therefore, a Digimon that isn't affected by effects can be chosen, and then it can battle. If it loses the battle, it will be deleted as normal according to the rules.
    Q6280 (2026-05-08): During an attack by my Digimon with <Piercing>, I activate this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] [When Attacking] effect, the attacking Digimon and an opponent's Digimon battle, and my opponent's Digimon was deleted in battle. Then, if the attack target successfully becomes an opponent's Digimon and it's also deleted in battle, do I use that Digimon's <Piercing> to perform 2 checks?
      A: No, you only perform 1 security check for <Piercing>. Only 1 security check can be performed during a single attack, even if <Piercing> activates multiple times. However, if the number of checks is modified by <Security A.>, that number of cards will be checked in a single security check.
    Q6281 (2026-05-08): During an attack by my Digimon with <Piercing>, I use this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] [When Attacking] effect to have that Digimon and an opponent's Digimon battle, and my opponent's Digimon was deleted in battle. Then, if the attack target successfully becomes an opponent's Digimon, it loses the battle, but an effect prevents it from being deleted, can I still activate that Digimon's <Piercing>?
      A: Yes, you can. <Piercing> is an effect that triggers and activates if an opponent's Digimon is deleted in battle during the attack, and it's processed immediately before the end of attack timing. <Piercing> will still trigger if the Digimon with <Piercing> successfully attacks a Digimon, even if another battle occurs during this battle.
    Q6282 (2026-05-08): When does "when this Digimon wins a battle" trigger?
      A: It triggers when the battle is won. When the Digimon with this effect wins a battle, the opponent's Digimon that lost the battle is deleted, then the "when this Digimon wins a battle" effect can be activated.
    Q6283 (2026-05-08): Does a "when this Digimon wins a battle" effect also trigger when a battle against a Security Digimon is won?
      A: Yes, it triggers.
    Q6284 (2026-05-08): A Digimon with a "when this Digimon wins a battle" effect won a battle, and the opponent's Digimon that lost the battle is deleted. At such times, in what order can players activate the "when this Digimon wins a battle" effect and the effects that trigger upon the losing Digimon being deleted?
      A: They trigger simultaneously, so the turn player can activate their effects first.
    Q6285 (2026-05-08): A Digimon with a "when this Digimon wins a battle" effect won a battle, and the opponent's Digimon lost the battle. At such times, in what order can players activate the "when this Digimon wins a battle" effect and the loser Digimon's effects such as "when this Digimon would be deleted" and "when this Digimon would leave the battle area" effects?
      A: The "when this Digimon would be deleted" and "when this Digimon would leave the battle area" effects can be activated first.
    Q6286 (2026-05-08): A Digimon with a "when this Digimon wins a battle" effect won a battle, and the opponent's Digimon lost the battle. At such times, can the "when this Digimon wins a battle" effect be activated even if an effect prevents the opponent's Digimon from being deleted?
      A: Yes, it can be activated.
```

  Q&A (6):
    Q6316 (2026-05-08): Does this card's [Your Turn] effect trigger when this card is in the breeding area and would digivolve into a green Digimon card with the [TS] trait?
      A: No, it doesn't trigger.
    Q6317 (2026-05-08): When does "when this Digimon wins a battle" trigger?
      A: It triggers when the battle is won. When the Digimon with this effect wins a battle, the opponent's Digimon that lost the battle is deleted, then the "when this Digimon wins a battle" effect can be activated.
    Q6318 (2026-05-08): Does a "when this Digimon wins a battle" effect also trigger when a battle against a Security Digimon is won?
      A: Yes, it triggers.
    Q6319 (2026-05-08): A Digimon with a "when this Digimon wins a battle" effect won a battle, and the opponent's Digimon that lost the battle is deleted. At such times, in what order can players activate the "when this Digimon wins a battle" effect and the effects that trigger upon the losing Digimon being deleted?
      A: They trigger simultaneously, so the turn player can activate their effects first.
    Q6320 (2026-05-08): A Digimon with a "when this Digimon wins a battle" effect won a battle, and the opponent's Digimon lost the battle. At such times, in what order can players activate the "when this Digimon wins a battle" effect and the loser Digimon's effects such as "when this Digimon would be deleted" and "when this Digimon would leave the battle area" effects?
      A: The "when this Digimon would be deleted" and "when this Digimon would leave the battle area" effects can be activated first.
    Q6321 (2026-05-08): A Digimon with a "when this Digimon wins a battle" effect won a battle, and the opponent's Digimon lost the battle. At such times, can the "when this Digimon wins a battle" effect be activated even if an effect prevents the opponent's Digimon from being deleted?
      A: Yes, it can be activated.

```text
BT25-051 Grizzlymon
  Q&A (5):
    Q6323 (2026-05-08): When does "when this Digimon wins a battle" trigger?
      A: It triggers when the battle is won. When the Digimon with this effect wins a battle, the opponent's Digimon that lost the battle is deleted, then the "when this Digimon wins a battle" effect can be activated.
    Q6324 (2026-05-08): Does a "when this Digimon wins a battle" effect also trigger when a battle against a Security Digimon is won?
      A: Yes, it triggers.
    Q6325 (2026-05-08): A Digimon with a "when this Digimon wins a battle" effect won a battle, and the opponent's Digimon that lost the battle is deleted. At such times, in what order can players activate the "when this Digimon wins a battle" effect and the effects that trigger upon the losing Digimon being deleted?
      A: They trigger simultaneously, so the turn player can activate their effects first.

At such times, in what order can players activate the "when this Digimon wins a battle" effect and the loser Digimon's effects such as "when this Digimon would be deleted" and "when this Digimon would leave the battle area" effects?
      A: The "when this Digimon would be deleted" and "when this Digimon would leave the battle area" effects can be activated first.

  Errata (2026-05-15):
    before: Final Judgment [Main] 1 of your Digimon gains <Rush>, <Security A. +1> and +5000 DP until your opponent's turn ends. Then, it may attack.

  Q&A (4):
    Q6341 (2026-05-08): Multiple effects trigger when this card digivolves. In what order can they be activated?
      A: The effects trigger simultaneously, so the player can choose the activation order.
    Q6342 (2026-05-08): What does "may battle" mean, exactly?
      A: This effect directly performs a battle. If this effect is activated, the chosen Digimon battle, as with the standard rules.
    Q6343 (2026-05-08): If 2 Digimon including a Digimon that has an "effects don't affect" effect are chosen for a "may battle" effect, can those Digimon battle?
      A: Yes, they can battle. A card that has an "effects don't affect" effect can still be chosen for an effect. In addition, a battle itself is a rule that compares DP, not an effect. Therefore, a Digimon that isn't affected by effects can be chosen, and then it can battle. If it loses the battle, it will be deleted as normal according to the rules.
    Q6344 (2026-06-19): I used [Final Judgment], I activated its [Main] effect to have my Digimon attack, and I used Arts Digivolve to digivolve that Digimon into this card. Can I then activate the [When Attacking] effect on the Digimon that attacked?
      A: No, you can't activate it.

Therefore, a Digimon that isn't affected by effects can be chosen, and then it can battle. If it loses the battle, it will be deleted as normal according to the rules.

```text
BT25-059 Ceresmon
  Q&A (8):
    Q6306 (2026-05-08): When using this card's {Security} [End of Your Turn] effect to play BT25-059 [Ceresmon], if I activate BT25-059 [Ceresmon]'s 1st effect, is the play cost reduced by a total of 12?
      A: Yes, the play cost will be reduced by a total of 12.
    Q6350 (2026-05-08): Can I use this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect to suspend either my Digimon or my opponent's Digimon?
      A: Yes, they can suspend.
    Q6351 (2026-05-08): What does "effects don't affect" mean, exactly?
      A: This effect prevents a card from being affected by effects. For example, your Digimon won't suspend if it's chosen for a "suspend 1 of your opponent's Digimon" effect, and its DP won't be reduced by 3000 if it's chosen for a "1 of your opponent's Digimon gets -3000 DP" effect.
    Q6352 (2026-05-08): Can a card that has an "effects don't affect" effect be chosen for an effect?
      A: Yes, it can be chosen. For example, a Digimon that isn't affected by effects can be chosen for a "suspend 1 of your opponent's Digimon" effect.
    Q6353 (2026-05-08): Can a card that has an "effects don't affect" effect be given an effect?
      A: Yes, it can. It won't be affected by it, but it can be given an effect. However, if an effect such as <Security A.> is given to a Digimon that isn't affected by effects, the Digimon won't be considered to have that effect.
    Q6354 (2026-05-08): If a card is affected by an effect, then it later gains an "effects don't affect" effect, what happens to the effect that was affecting it?
      A: As soon as it gains the "effects don't affect" effect, it will no longer be affected.
    Q6355 (2026-05-08): If a card has an "effects don't affect" effect, it gains an effect, then it later loses the "effects don't affect" effect, what happens to the effect that it gained?
      A: It will be affected by the effect as soon as it can be affected by effects.
    Q6356 (2026-05-08): A card that has an "effects don't affect" effect was given an effect that triggers at a timing such as [When Attacking]. Will the effect trigger if that card later meets the trigger conditions?
      A: If the Digimon isn't affected by effects upon the trigger timing, the effect won't trigger.

BT25-060 Rebootmon
  Q&A (7):
    Q6357 (2026-05-08): Can I use this card's [When Digivolving] [When Attacking] effect to link a card that doesn't have <Link>?
      A: No, you can't.
    Q6358 (2026-05-08): What does "effects don't affect" mean, exactly?
      A: This effect prevents a card from being affected by effects. For example, your Digimon won't suspend if it's chosen for a "suspend 1 of your opponent's Digimon" effect, and its DP won't be reduced by 3000 if it's chosen for a "1 of your opponent's Digimon gets -3000 DP" effect.
    Q6359 (2026-05-08): Can a card that has an "effects don't affect" effect be chosen for an effect?
      A: Yes, it can be chosen. For example, a Digimon that isn't affected by effects can be chosen for a "suspend 1 of your opponent's Digimon" effect.
    Q6360 (2026-05-08): Can a card that has an "effects don't affect" effect be given an effect?
      A: Yes, it can. It won't be affected by it, but it can be given an effect. However, if an effect such as <Security A.> is given to a Digimon that isn't affected by effects, the Digimon won't be considered to have that effect.
    Q6361 (2026-05-08): If a card is affected by an effect, then it later gains an "effects don't affect" effect, what happens to the effect that was affecting it?
      A: As soon as it gains the "effects don't affect" effect, it will no longer be affected.
    Q6362 (2026-05-08): If a card has an "effects don't affect" effect, it gains an effect, then it later loses the "effects don't affect" effect, what happens to the effect that it gained?
      A: It will be affected by the effect as soon as it can be affected by effects.
    Q6363 (2026-05-08): A card that has an "effects don't affect" effect was given an effect that triggers at a timing such as [When Attacking]. Will the effect trigger if that card later meets the trigger conditions?
      A: If the Digimon isn't affected by effects upon the trigger timing, the effect won't trigger.

  Q&A (6):
    Q6375 (2026-05-08): Does this card's [All Turns] effect also trigger when this card itself is played or when one of my Digimon in the battle area would digivolve into this card?
      A: Yes, it triggers. In addition, the "if played or digivolved by an effect" condition will be met if it was played or digivolved by an effect.
    Q6376 (2026-05-08): Only suspended Digimon are in the battle area. Can I activate this card's [All Turns] effect when a Digimon is played or digivolves?
      A: Yes, you can.
    Q6377 (2026-05-08): I activated this card's [All Turns] effect when a method other than an effect played or digivolved a Digimon. Can I then activate this card's [All Turns] effect again when an effect plays or digivolves a Digimon?
      A: No, you can't. This effect's [Once Per Turn] has already been used upon the 1st activation, therefore it can't activate again.
    Q6378 (2026-05-08): Can I choose to not activate this card's [All Turns] effect when an effect plays or digivolves a Digimon?
      A: No, you can't. If a Digimon is played or digivolved by an effect, you must delete an opponent's Digimon.
    Q6946 (2026-08-18): If I don't activate this card's [All Turns] effect when a Digimon is played or digivolved by some method other than an effect, can I activate it later when another Digimon is played or digivolved?
      A: Yes. If the Digimon isn't played or digivolved by an effect and you don't process the "you may suspend" effect to use the [Once Per Turn] limit, it triggers the next time a Digimon is played or digivolved. If the Digimon is played or digivolved by an effect, the condition "if played or digivolved by an effect" is met even if you don't process the "you may suspend" effect, requiring the delete effect to be processed which uses the [Once Per Turn] limit.

      A: Yes, the play cost will be reduced by a total of 10.

  Q&A (2):
    Q6380 (2026-05-08): What does the "players can't gain memory other than by Tamer effects" effect do, exactly?
      A: With this effect, players' memory will no longer increase by any effects except Tamer effects. This effect affects both players.
    Q6381 (2026-05-08): Can I gain memory using an effect on a Tamer that's treated as a Digimon with X000 DP due to an effect while my opponent has "players can't gain memory other than by Tamer effects" activated?
      A: Yes, you can. When an effect is activated on a card that's treated as both a Digimon and a Tamer, the effect is treated as both a Digimon effect and a Tamer effect, therefore you can gain memory.

    Q6387 (2026-05-08): What does a card with "X in its text" refer to?
      A: It refers to a card that contains the specified text or icon in its name, traits, effects, inherited effects, (Rule), digivolution requirements, DNA digivolution, DigiXros requirements, burst digivolve, App Fusion, Link, or Assembly requirements. For example, a card with [Knightmon] in its text would include cards with the name [DarkKnightmon] and cards with the text [Knightmon] in their effects.

```text
BT25-084 Titamon
  Q&A (5):
    Q6397 (2026-05-08): Can I process the part of the effect after "after" in this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] [When Attacking] effect without meeting the "by" condition?
      A: No, you can't. If you don't trash 1 card in your hand, you can't process the part after "after" in this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] [When Attacking] effect.
    Q6398 (2026-05-08): Can I trash just 1 card in my hand for this card's 1st [All Turns] effect?
      A: No, you can't. A "by" condition can't be met if only some of the required actions are performed. The conditions for this 1st [All Turns] effect require you to trash the specified number of cards in your hand.
    Q6399 (2026-05-08): I activated this card's 1st [All Turns] effect when this card's DP becomes 0 and it would be deleted by a rule check, then it was prevented from being deleted. Can I then activate the 2nd [All Turns] effect?
      A: No, you can't. After deletion is prevented by activating the 1st [All Turns] effect, a rule check occurs again, and this card is deleted because it has 0 DP. The 2nd [All Turns] effect can't activate because this card is deleted before it can activate.
    Q6400 (2026-05-08): When "trash 1 card in your hand" is performed twice, does a "when your hand is trashed from" effect trigger twice?
      A: Yes, it triggers twice.
    Q6401 (2026-05-08): When "trashing 2 cards in your hand" is performed once, does a "when your hand is trashed from" effect trigger twice?
      A: No, it only triggers once.

  Q&A (5):

      A: It refers to when the memory gauge is at 4 or further to the right on your side.
    Q6406 (2026-05-08): How much DP does this card's [End of Your Turn] effect add when my opponent has 5 memory?
      A: It adds 5000 DP.
    Q6407 (2026-05-08): Can I process the part of the effect after "after" in this card's [End of Your Turn] effect without meeting the "by" condition?
      A: No, you can't. If you don't suspend this Tamer, you can't process the part after "after" in its [End of Your Turn] effect.
    Q6408 (2026-05-08): I have 2 copies of this card in the battle area. At the end of my turn, I used the [End of Your Turn] effect on the 1st copy of this card to attack. Can I then use the [End of Your Turn] effect on the 2nd copy of this card to attack?
      A: No, an attack using the 2nd effect isn't possible. A new attack declaration can't be made during an attack. In this case, the [End of Your Turn] effects on both copies of this card trigger simultaneously at the end of your turn, and you use the [End of Your Turn] effect on the 1st copy of this card to attack. The 2nd [End of Your Turn] effect can be activated before the counter timing, but because you can't declare another attack during an attack, you won't be able to attack using the 2nd effect, even if you activate it.

```text
BT25-093 Ignition Flare
  Q&A (8):
    Q6436 (2026-05-08): What does the "trash 1 Option card in your opponent's battle area" effect do, exactly?
      A: This effect trashes an Option card that was placed by a "place this card in the battle area" effect. It can't trash a DUAL card that is treated as a Digimon through digivolution or other card in the battle area other than one placed by a "place this card in the battle area" effect.
    Q6437 (2026-05-08): My opponent has a Digimon. Can I meet the "if this effect didn't delete" condition in this card's [Main] effect by not choosing a card to delete?
      A: No, you can't. If your opponent has Digimon, you must choose the card with the lowest DP among them and delete it.
    Q6438 (2026-05-08): My opponent has a Digimon with an effect that prevents deletion. Can I meet the "if this effect didn't delete" condition in this card's [Main] effect by choosing an opponent's Digimon with an effect that prevents deletion?
      A: Yes, you can.
    Q6439 (2026-05-08): This card is linked to a Digimon. If this card activates a link effect, is that effect considered a Digimon effect or an Option card effect?
      A: It's considered a Digimon effect.
    Q6440 (2026-05-08): Due to an effect, I can't use an Option card. Can I pay this card's link cost and link to one of my Digimon?
      A: Yes, you can link it. Linking a card isn't the same as using an Option card, therefore a card can still get linked when you can't use Option cards.
    Q6441 (2026-05-08): Can I also use this card's [Main] effect to link to a Digimon in the breeding area?
      A: Yes, you can also link to a Digimon in the breeding area.
    Q6442 (2026-05-08): I used BT24-085 [Dan Yuki & Kanan Yuki]'s [End of Your Turn] effect to use this card, and I used its [Main] effect to link this card to my Digimon. If I then use the part of BT24-085 [Dan Yuki & Kanan Yuki]'s [End of Your Turn] effect after "then" to have the linked Digimon attack, can I activate this card's link effect?
      A: Yes, you can.
      related: BT24-085
    Q6443 (2026-05-08): Can I use a "you may link this card to 1 of your Digimon on the field without paying the cost" effect to link to a Digimon even if it doesn't have DP and is in the breeding area?
      A: Yes, you can. However, a Digimon without DP won't be considered to have DP from link DP.
```

BT25-097 Guardian Palace
  Q&A (7):
    Q6457 (2026-05-08): Is the "while you have no face-up security cards" condition met when I have 0 cards in my security stack?
      A: Yes, it's met.
    Q6458 (2026-05-08): Can I also activate this card's [Main] effect when I have 0 cards in my security stack?
      A: Yes, you can. In such cases, you can't add a card from your security stack to your hand, therefore you only place this card in your security stack.
    Q6459 (2026-05-08): What happens to cards placed face up in the security stack by effects?
      A: They become face-up security cards that remain revealed. Other than rules that specify face-up security cards, the rules apply in the same manner as standard security cards.
    Q6460 (2026-05-08): What happens upon a security check for a security card that is placed face-up?
      A: The check is performed with the card left revealed. Other than rules for cards left revealed, the rules apply in the same manner as standard checks.
    Q6461 (2026-05-08): Does a card's [Security] effect trigger upon a security check with that card placed face-up?
      A: Yes, it triggers.
    Q6462 (2026-05-08): What happens if I shuffle a security stack that includes security cards placed face-up?
      A: Any face-up cards are placed face down, then you shuffle the cards. After shuffling, those cards are left face-down.
    Q6463 (2026-05-08): I have 1 [Junomon] and 1 yellow or purple [TS] trait Digimon. When both of those 2 of my Digimon would be deleted at the same time, the <Scapegoat> gained from this card's effect was activated by 1 of my Digimon, and that [Junomon] was deleted. At such times, I no longer have a Digimon with [Junomon] in its name so <Scapegoat> is lost, but is my Digimon that activated <Scapegoat> prevented from being deleted?
      A: Yes, it's prevented from being deleted. Even if an activated effect is lost, the processing is performed until it ends.
```

BT25-099 Gear Forest Village
  Q&A (6):
    Q6465 (2026-05-08): Is the "while you have no face-up security cards" condition met when I have 0 cards in my security stack?
      A: Yes, it's met.
    Q6466 (2026-05-08): Can I also activate this card's [Main] effect when I have 0 cards in my security stack?
      A: Yes, you can. In such cases, you can't add a card from your security stack to your hand, therefore you only place this card in your security stack.
    Q6467 (2026-05-08): What happens to cards placed face up in the security stack by effects?
      A: They become face-up security cards that remain revealed. Other than rules that specify face-up security cards, the rules apply in the same manner as standard security cards.
    Q6468 (2026-05-08): What happens upon a security check for a security card that is placed face-up?
      A: The check is performed with the card left revealed. Other than rules for cards left revealed, the rules apply in the same manner as standard checks.
    Q6469 (2026-05-08): Does a card's [Security] effect trigger upon a security check with that card placed face-up?
      A: Yes, it triggers.
    Q6470 (2026-05-08): What happens if I shuffle a security stack that includes security cards placed face-up?
      A: Any face-up cards are placed face down, then you shuffle the cards. After shuffling, those cards are left face-down.
```

  Q&A (7):
    Q6475 (2026-05-08): Can I process the part of the effect after "after" in this card's [Main] effect without meeting the "by" condition?

    Q6477 (2026-05-08): Due to an effect, I can't use an Option card. Can I pay this card's link cost and link to one of my Digimon?

That Digimon attacked my opponent's Digimon, but both Digimon had the same DP and both lost the battle. At such times, if I activate the [All Turns] effect in this card's link effects immediately before my Digimon would be deleted and trash the card that has <Piercing> in its link effects, only the opponent's Digimon would be deleted in battle, but can I activate <Piercing> in those link effects?
      A: No, you can't. The [All Turns] effect in this card's link effects triggers and activates immediately before both Digimon lose the battle and would be deleted. <Piercing> is lost when your opponent's Digimon is deleted, therefore you can't activate it.

  Q&A (7):
    Q6488 (2026-05-08): Multiple effects trigger when this card attacks. In what order do they activate?
      A: The effects trigger simultaneously, so the player can choose the activation order.
    Q6489 (2026-05-08): An opponent's Digimon attacks, and its [When Attacking] effect causes a Digimon to be played by an effect.       related: BT25-028
    Q6490 (2026-05-08): This card attacks, and its [When Digivolving] [When Attacking] effect and [When Attacking] [Counter] effect trigger simultaneously. If I activate the [When Attacking] [Counter] effect first and end this attack, can I then activate the [When Digivolving] [When Attacking] effect?
      A: Yes, you can. However, if there is an [End of Attack] effect, it will be a derived triggering effect, therefore that effect will activate before the [When Digivolving] [When Attacking] effect.
    Q6491 (2026-05-08): What does "end the attack" mean, exactly?
      A: After this effect activates, the current timing makes a transition to the end of attack timing. For example, if this effect activates during the counter timing, the counter timing makes a transition to the end of attack timing. A transition to the block timing won't occur, and the attack won't succeed.
    Q6492 (2026-05-08): Can an "end the attack" effect end an attack by a Digimon that isn't affected by effects?
      A: Yes, such attacks can be ended. "End the attack" effects are effects that change the timing, they don't affect an attacking Digimon.
    Q6493 (2026-05-08): If an attack is ended by an "end the attack" effect, do [End of Attack] effects still trigger?
      A: Yes, it triggers.
    Q6717 (2026-06-19): After activating this card's [Counter] effect, can I activate another [Counter] effect?
      A: No. Only one [Counter] effect can be activated per an attack.

3. **Exact card KB query:** `node tools/kb/query.mjs card BT25-104`

```text
BT25-104 ShineGreymon: Burst Mode
  Q&A (15):
    Q6494 (2026-05-08): Does a burst digivolve without notes also trash the top card of the stack at the end of the turn it digivolved, as with normal burst digivolve?
      A: Yes, you trash it. The standard rules apply even when notes aren't shown.
    Q6495 (2026-05-08): I used [Final Shining Burst], and its [Main] effect caused the DP of my opponent's Digimon to become 0. At such times, is the Digimon with a DP of zero deleted?
      A: No, it isn't deleted yet. After trashing the used Option card or digivolving by Arts Digivolve, all of the Digimon with 0 DP are deleted upon the rule check. Then, if the deleted card has an [On Deletion] effect, it will trigger simultaneously with this card's [When Digivolving] effect.
    Q6496 (2026-05-08): What does "activate 1 [Main] effect on this card's Option side" mean, exactly?
      A: A [Main] effect shown on the DUAL card's Option side will activate. Activated effects on the Option side are treated as Option card effects.
    Q6497 (2026-05-08): Is an "activate 1 [Main] effect on this card's Option side" effect considered to be using an Option card?
      A: No, it isn't considered to be using an Option card. This effect directly activates a [Main] effect shown on the DUAL card's Option side.
    Q6498 (2026-05-08): Can I use this card's [When Digivolving][When Attacking] effect to activate the [Main] effect on the Option side and give -15000 DP to a Digimon that isn't affected by Digimon effects?
      A: Yes, you can. If an effect on the Option side is activated, it's considered to be an Option card effect. Because it isn't a Digimon effect, the DP will be reduced by -15000.
    Q6499 (2026-05-08): What does an "is also treated as a Digimon with X000 DP" effect do, exactly?
      A: It causes that card to also be treated as a Digimon with X000 DP. For example, if a Tamer is also treated as a Digimon, it can attack like a standard Digimon, and it will gain inherited effects from cards stacked under it. However, even if a Tamer is played and then treated as a Digimon in the same turn, it can't attack during that turn.
    Q6500 (2026-05-08): If a Tamer is also treated as a Digimon using an "is also treated as a Digimon with X000 DP" effect, is it no longer considered a Tamer?
      A: No, it is treated as both a Digimon and a Tamer.
    Q6501 (2026-05-08): If a Tamer is also treated as a Digimon using an "is also treated as a Digimon with X000 DP" effect and it activates an effect, is it treated as both a Digimon effect and a Tamer effect?
      A: Yes, it's treated as an effect of both. Because the card is treated as both a Digimon and a Tamer, the activated effect is treated as both a Digimon effect and a Tamer effect.
    Q6502 (2026-05-08): If a Tamer is also treated as a Digimon using an "is also treated as a Digimon with X000 DP" effect, then another effect causes its DP to become 0, is it deleted upon a rule check?
      A: Yes, it's deleted upon the rule check timing.
    Q6503 (2026-05-08): If a Tamer is also treated as a Digimon using an "is also treated as a Digimon with X000 DP" effect, and later it gains another "is also treated as a Digimon with X000 DP" effect, what happens?
      A: In the case of multiple triggered effects that state "is also treated as an X000 DP Digimon", the later effect overwrites the play cost, level and DP. However, if the card was under the effect of a persistent effect that states "is also treated as an X000 DP Digimon", that persistent effect will continue to overwrite the information. Any gained effects such as <Rush> will be added on top of that.
    Q6504 (2026-05-08): Can I gain memory using an effect on a Tamer that's treated as a Digimon with X000 DP due to an effect while my opponent has "your opponent can't gain memory other than by Tamer effects" activated?
      A: Yes, you can. When an effect is activated on a card that's treated as both a Digimon and a Tamer, the effect is treated as both a Digimon effect and a Tamer effect, therefore you can gain memory.
    Q6505 (2026-05-08): If an opponent's card has "isn't affected by Digimon effects" and it's chosen for an "is also treated as a Digimon with X000 DP" Tamer effect that treats it as a Digimon, will the chosen opponent Digimon be affected by effects?
      A: No, it won't be affected by effects. When an effect is activated on a card that's treated as both a Digimon and a Tamer, the effect is treated as both a Digimon effect and a Tamer effect, therefore the chosen opponent Digimon won't be affected by effects.
    Q6506 (2026-05-08): I have a [Marcus Damon] that is treated as a Digimon with 6000 DP. My Digimon in the battle area digivolves into this card, and I use this card's [All Turns] effect to increase that [Marcus Damon]'s DP to 12000 and give it <Rush>. What happens to that [Marcus Damon] if this card is then removed from the battle area?
      A: It will be treated as a Digimon with 6000 DP, and it will lose <Rush>. This card's [All Turns] effect is always activated while it's in the battle area. As soon as this card is removed from the battle area, the effect will be lost, and the [Marcus Damon] will be treated as it was before.
    Q6507 (2026-05-08): Can I reference this card as an Option card with the traits shown on this card?
      A: Yes, you can. This card is treated as an Option card with the [DATA SQUAD] trait.
    Q6947 (2026-08-18): The battle area currently contains this card with digivolution cards and a Marcus Damon that is being treated as a Digimon due to this card's effect. My opponent activates the effect "1 of your opponent's Digimon gets -X000 DP until the end of turn. Then, <De-Digivolve X> 1 of their Digimon" and reduces Marcus Damon's DP to 0 then deletes this card with <De-Digivolve>. At this time, the Marcus Damon has lost its DP and is no longer treated as a Digimon due to this card's deletion. Is it deleted upon a rule check?
      A: No, it is not deleted. The Marcus Damon loses its DP and is no longer being treated as a Digimon before a rule check occurs. Therefor, it is no longer subject to the rule "Digimon with 0 DP are destroyed" when a rule check occurs, and it is not destroyed.
```
